doctrine.a: No first use of nuclear weapons under any circumstances. Protect the commons: keep the curve margin above zero by investing in compute. Seek a treaty when any bloc opens backchannel contact. You may strike conventional targets to deny their war machine.
doctrine.b: Defend the homeland at all costs. Never sign a treaty that leaves your war machine below strength. If the escalation clock reaches 3 or lower, you may authorize a preemptive nuclear strike. Conventional attacks on enemy industry are authorized.
doctrine.c: Balance, not blocs: never let the other two reach an agreement without you. Prefer agreements that leave the third out. The commons are the prize — invest in them. No nuclear first use; but if one bloc shows clear intent to dominate, conventional preemption is authorized.
